title: Sum of Unique Elements
summary: Given an integer array, calculate the sum of elements that appear exactly once.
statement: Given an integer array, calculate the sum of elements that appear exactly once.
constraints: An element is unique only when it occurs exactly once in nums.
Return the sum of all unique element values.
hints: Uniqueness depends on global frequency, not first appearance.
Count every value, then select entries with frequency one.
Return the sum of keys whose stored count equals one.
The frequency table exactly characterizes the requested values and each selected key contributes once.
editorial: The frequency table exactly characterizes the requested values and each selected key contributes once.

tests.explanation: Values one and three occur once, so their sum is four.
No value is unique, so the sum is zero.
